reason: DSH Crew primarily orchestrates DSH worker agents from Claude Code and Codex, with synchronous or asynchronous dispatch, progress tracking, cancellation, tier policies, and optional multimodal provider integration.

summaries.zh: DSH Crew 将任务从 Claude Code 或 Codex 分发给具备独立会话、工具和进度反馈的 DSH 智能体。
summaries.en: DSH Crew dispatches tasks from Claude Code or Codex to DSH agents with independent sessions, configurable tiers, and progress tracking.

capabilities: dispatches synchronous and asynchronous tasks to DSH worker agents
launches or terminates worker runtime processes
calls configured DeepSeek and other external model providers
reads and writes local plugin, status, and host integration configuration
installs or updates Claude Code and Codex integration files
